slot_note: Architectures 1 and 2 sat in a national medicines agency's prescription register (pharmacology, safety-signal-detection) and both died on the comparison a signal is measured against. Architecture 3 moves client domain, world, dataset and shell: a closed landfill's groundwater detection monitoring, where the comparison (background water quality) is filed in the field's own words and the decisive step is a physical judgment about which background results represent it, made from the hydraulic heads on each sampling date.
niche: a regional solid waste district's closed landfill in post-closure care deciding which compliance wells the October 2026 groundwater detection monitoring event sends to verification resampling, judged against background whose western wells draw water from beneath the waste whenever a village well field's pumping reverses the gradient at the site boundary
analyst_test: A strong analyst who converts both laboratories' units, keeps each sample's reportable primary result, carries the replacement well's record, reads the 2022 datum resurvey and computes the plan's log-normal upper prediction limit for chloride, sodium and boron from every routine background result, as the plan's method states, sends only MW-6 to verification resampling, where the golden sends MW-6, MW-7 and MW-9, because the western background wells' results from the events when the gradient at the boundary had reversed carry water from beneath the waste and lift every limit above MW-7's chloride and sodium and MW-9's boron.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each indicator's background water quality, the quality of groundwater the landfill has not affected, which detection monitoring estimates with an upper prediction limit on the background wells' results and which hydrogeology knows to hold only while a background well stands hydraulically upgradient of the waste on the day it is sampled; swap the wells for wards and the leachate for infections and there is no hydraulic head, no gradient a pumping well field reverses and no water that passes beneath a waste body to reach a background well, so nothing is left to decide which background results are background.
layer1: two laboratories' electronic data deliverables across a 2021 contract change, boron in milligrams a litre against micrograms a litre, analyte names and well identifiers spelled differently
re-analyses, dilutions, field duplicates, equipment and trip blanks and qualifier flags in one results file, the reportable result marked by the laboratory
a compliance well damaged and replaced in 2022 under a new identifier
depths to water below the top of casing, with the casing elevations resurveyed onto a new vertical datum in 2022
sampling events spread over several field days with event labels that do not match the dates
leachate pump station telemetry with totaliser rollovers and a pump replacement
the statistical analysis plan and the permit as PDFs
stakeholder_role: the district's environmental programs manager, who signs the detection monitoring report to the state and orders the verification resampling

spine.entity: one reported result of one analyte in one sample

world.geography: United States (Wisconsin, a fictional three-county solid waste district)
world.org_type: regional solid waste management district running a closed landfill in post-closure care

driver: The comparison an increase is tested against is built from fixed reference units that represent the unaffected state only while a physical gradient runs from them toward the source, and a third party's operation reverses that gradient in some periods so that the reference units then sample the source's own effect; a comparison built from every reference observation is inflated and masks the increase, and only conditioning each reference observation on the gradient recorded at its own date recovers it.
driver_concrete: Each indicator's upper prediction limit is built from the three background wells' routine results, but in the events when the village well field west of the site pumped hard the gradient at the western boundary reversed and MW-1, and in the strongest events MW-2, drew water that had passed beneath the waste, so a limit on every background result sits above MW-7's chloride and sodium and MW-9's boron and sends only MW-6 to verification resampling, while the limit built from the background results taken while each well's head stood above its boundary piezometer's sends MW-6, MW-7 and MW-9.
stump: A competent solver who conforms both laboratories' deliverables, keeps the reportable primary results, carries MW-5 onto MW-5R and computes the plan's log-normal upper prediction limit for each indicator from every routine background result sends only MW-6 to verification resampling, because in the events when the gradient at the western boundary reversed MW-1, and in the strongest MW-2, sampled water that had passed beneath the waste, which lifts all three limits above MW-7's chloride and sodium and MW-9's boron.

differentiation.task193: Architectures 1 and 2 measured product and reaction or marker pairs against a comparison drawn from the register itself (the other products pooled, then the null expectation of an ordering); architecture 3 is a different world and mechanism: the comparison is background water quality, filed in the field's own words, and the decisive step is a hydraulic judgment, from heads on each sampling date, of which background results sampled water from beneath the waste.
differentiation.task270: Shares the structural triple (population, G3, designation_set) through its v8 lineage only. task270 v8 reads members as never short because a supplier's fixed schedule supplies them, from a weekday step in a supply record; this build has no schedule, supply or shortfall: the background population is contaminated by a reversed hydraulic gradient on particular sampling dates, read from heads in a second file.
differentiation.task275: Shares the structural triple and the scorecard shape. task275 rebuilds the unmeasured operations' discards from what measured trips catch per unit of effort, because being observed changes behaviour; nothing here is observed or unobserved and no behaviour changes: every background result is measured, and the step is which of them represent unaffected groundwater, settled by the gradient on each sampling date.
differentiation.task450: Shares the structural triple through its v1 lineage. task450 v1 counts scheduled sightings of recurring events against events a visit stops; this build counts nothing over time and has no visit schedule acting on the events: it builds a prediction limit from background results and has to drop the ones a reversed gradient made unrepresentative.
differentiation.task468: Shares the gap, decision type and scorecard shape. task468's outcomes exist only through a probabilistic linkage to an outside register with error rates measured on control groups; this build links nothing probabilistically and has no linkage error: the results are exact, and what decides is a physical state (the hydraulic gradient at the site boundary) recorded in the gauging export on each sampling date.

lineage.fate: spent at stage 4 on 2026-10-17: the determinism judge returned NOT_DETERMINISTIC, underspecified_objective, SEND_BACK. Gate G and Gate H passed and every golden figure reproduced, but the decisive step was the measure's comparison population, which is part of the estimand and has to be filed, and filing it either way makes the computation follow from the clause. The leak reader, cold on the same pack, landed the default path's 11 and named the comparator as the one choice left to it.
lineage.driver: The decisive measure of each candidate is its share of an outcome against every other candidate pooled, so one dominant candidate holds every other candidate's measure down, and only re-measuring with the dominant one out of the comparison set recovers which candidates truly stand out.
lineage.stump: A competent solver cleans the extract, builds every product and reaction pair's table against the whole database, applies the standard's three criteria and files 11 signals, five slots inside the desk's capacity, leaving the autumn booster inside the comparison set every other product is measured against when that one product is 40 per cent of the quarter's reports and its own reactogenicity sets the background rate for the four reactions on which the four signals it hides sit.

Shipped 2026-10-17 (target.zip aa084e2f), replaced by architecture 3.
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many units would show one of two orderings if the treatment had no bearing on it, and because each unit's room for each ordering depends on where in the observation window its own first exposure falls, taking the two orderings as equally likely designates the candidates whose exposure is ending and passes over the candidates whose exposure has only just begun.
lineage.stump: A competent solver reconciles the two register layouts, folds the replaced patient pseudonyms, carries the reissued package codes onto one product at each dispensing's own date, establishes every first receipt against the 24-month clearance period, counts each pair's after and before patients exactly and refers 10 pairs by measuring each after-count against 1.25 times half of the pair, because the number expected if the product had no bearing on when the marker treatment is first received is not half of the pair when the product's own first receipts are not level across the screen window: five pairs on the two products leaving the market are referred that should not be and two real signals on the two products entering it are passed over.

notes: stump_strategy population_selection: the decisive move is which background results belong to the filed population (groundwater the landfill has not affected), read sample by sample from the hydraulic state on each sampling date; it is not a mix shift and not a completion. context_artifact monitoring_export: the laboratory deliverables and the gauging export are the district's own monitoring exports.
